name: balanced-blue-scattering
limitations: Reflection and refraction remain live ray-traced scene content; their balance is an artistic fit to the painted movie image, not a measurement of optical constants.
Scattering color is approximated at the existing water surface and excludes shadow illumination; it is not a bounded volumetric water simulation.
Submerged algae uses procedural world-space coloration on existing stone geometry; exact stone outlines and glint locations still require calibration.
Browser reflection blur and algae noise are approximations of the native materials; matching across render engines has not been visually verified.
